patches.note: engine + bind; the paused / repaint entry (e1 is called with the canvas, the map, the placements, the tick, selection, pin and filters) goes to the engine, the shipped body stays as the fallback
the playing frame: the shipped loop keeps the clock (tick accumulator, store writes, data prefetch, casualty flash); drawing goes to the engine, which draws in the map render event
end of the battle: the final frame
the 30 fps cap of the shipped phone path is not applied to the engine (it adapts itself)
every other consumer of y1 (minimap, picker index, fly-to) sees the same continuous positions the engine draws
desktop pick: the tile under the pointer as drawn (selectUnit + pinUnit), empty ground deselects
phone pick, same contract as the shipped handler (selection popup record, select, pin)

ONLY with MON (the anchor lies in the MON runtime): the Monuments click arbitration asks which unit is nearest to the pointer; it must use the positions the engine drew, not the latest keyframe. In the registered design the one line lives in the MON source itself.
GtbgRepaint (every map move while paused) must not reset the backing store the engine sized for the device pixel ratio
